H8100.def: feminine of «08088»; annunciation; Shimath, an Ammonitess:--Shimath.

H8101.def: patronymically from «08093»; a Shimathite (collectively) or descendants of Shimah:--Shimeathites.

H8102.et: from an unused root meaning to emit a sound
H8102.def: from an unused root meaning to emit a sound; an inkling:--a little.

H8103.def: feminine of «08102»; scornful whispering (of hostile spectators):--shame.

H8104.def: a primitive root; properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.:--beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

H8105.def: from «08104»; something preserved, i.e. the settlings (plural only) of wine:--dregs, (wines on the) lees.

H8106.def: the same as «08105»; Shemer, the name of three Israelites:--Shamer, Shemer.

H8108.et: of an unused noun from (08104) meaning a guard
H8108.def: feminine of an unused noun from «08104» meaning a guard; watchfulness:--watch.

H8109.def: feminine of passive participle of «08104»; something guarded, i.e. an eye-lid:--waking.

H8110.def: from «08105» in its original sense; guardianship; Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine:--Shimron.

H8111.def: from the active participle of «08104»; watch-station; Shomeron, a place in Palestine:--Samaria.

H8112.def: from «08110» and a derivative of «04754»; guard of lashing; Shimron-Meron, a place in Palestine:--Shimon-meron.

H8113.def: from «08105» in its original sense; watchful; Shimri, the name of four Israelites:--Shimri.

H8114.def: or Shmaryahuw {shem-ar-yaw'-hoo}; from «08104» and «03050»; Jah has guarded; Shemarjah, the name of four Israelites:--Shamariah, Shemariah.

H8115.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08111»; Shomrain, a place in Palestine:--Samaria.

H8116.def: feminine of «08113»; female guard; Shimrith, a Moabitess:--Shimrith.

H8117.def: patronymically from «08110»; a Shimronite (collectively) or descendants of Shimron:--Shimronites.

H8118.def: patrial from «08111»; a Shomeronite (collectively) or inhabitants of Shomeron:--Samaritans.

H8120.et: corresponding to the root of (08121) through the idea of activity implied in day-light
H8120.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of «08121» through the idea of activity implied in day-light; to serve:--minister.

H8121.et: from an unused root meaning to be brilliant
H8121.def: from an unused root meaning to be brilliant; the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (arch.) a notched battlement:--+ east side(-ward), sun ((rising)), + west(-ward), window. See also «01053».

H8125.def: apparently from «08121»; sunlike; Shamsherai, an Israelite:--Shamsherai.

H8126.et: patronymically from an unused name from (07762) probably meaning garlic-smell
H8126.def: patronymically from an unused name from «07762» probably meaning garlic-smell; a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah:--Shumathites.

H8127.def: from «08150»; a tooth (as sharp); specifically (for «08143») ivory; figuratively, a cliff:--crag, × forefront, ivory, × sharp, tooth.

H8129.def: the same as «08127»; crag; Shen, a place in Palestine:--Shen.

H8130.def: a primitive root; to hate (personally):--enemy, foe, (be) hate(-ful, -r), odious, × utterly.

H8134.def: probably from «08132» and «01»; a father has turned; Shinab, a Canaanite:--Shinab.

H8137.def: apparently of Babylonian origin; Shenatstsar, an Israelite:--Senazar.

H8138.def: a primitive root; to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive):--do (speak, strike) again, alter, double, (be given to) change, disguise, (be) diverse, pervert, prefer, repeat, return, do the second time.

H8141.def: (in plura or (feminine) shanah {shaw-naw'}; from «08138»; a year (as a revolution of time):--+ whole age, × long, + old, year(X -ly).

H8143.et: from (08127) and the pl. apparently of a foreign word
H8143.def: from «08127» and the plural apparently of a foreign word; probably, tooth of elephants, i.e. ivory tusk:--ivory.

H8144.def: of uncertain derivation; crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it:--crimson, scarlet (thread).

H8145.def: from «08138»; properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again:--again, either (of them), (an-)other, second (time).

H8147.def: dual of «08145»; feminine shttayim {shet-tah'-yim}; two; also (as ordinal) twofold:--both, couple, double, second, twain, + twelfth, + twelve, + twenty (sixscore) thousand, twice, two.

H8148.def: from «08150»; something pointed, i.e. a gibe:--byword, taunt.

H8149.et: from an unused root meaning to be pointed
H8149.def: or Sniyr {sen-eer'}; from an unused root meaning to be pointed; peak; Shenir or Senir, a summit of Lebanon:--Senir, Shenir.

H8150.def: a primitive root; to point (transitive or intransitive); intensively, to pierce; figuratively, to inculcate:--prick, sharp(-en), teach diligently, whet.

H8151.def: a primitive root; to compress (with a belt):--gird up.

H8152.def: probably of foreign derivation; Shinar, a plain in Babylonia:--Shinar.

H8154.def: or shasah (Isa. 10:13) {shaw-saw'}; a primitive root; to plunder:--destroyer, rob, spoil(-er).

H8155.def: a primitive root; to plunder:--rifle, spoil.

H8156.def: a primitive root; to split or tear; figuratively, to upbraid:--cleave, (be) cloven ((footed)), rend, stay.

H8158.def: a primitive root; to cut in pieces, i.e. slaughter:--hew in pieces.

H8159.def: a primitive root; to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered:--depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

H8160.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «08159»; properly, a look, i.e. a moment:--hour.

H8161.et: from an unused root meaning to stamp
H8161.def: feminine from an unused root meaning to stamp; a clatter (of hoofs):--stamping.

H8162.def: probably of foreign derivation; linsey- woolsey, i.e. cloth of linen and wool carded and spun together:--garment of divers sorts, linen and wollen.

H8163.def: or sabir {saw-eer'}; from «08175»; shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun:--devil, goat, hairy, kid, rough, satyr.

H8164.def: formed the same as «08163»; a shower (as tempestuous):--small rain.

H8165.def: formed like «08163»; rough; Seir, a mountain of Idumaea and its aboriginal occupants, also one in Palestine:--Seir.

H8167.def: formed as «08166»; roughness; Seirah, a place in Palestine:--Seirath.

H8168.et: from an unused root meaning to hollow out
H8168.def: from an unused root meaning to hollow out; the palm; by extension, a handful:--handful, hollow of the hand.

H8169.def: or Sha.alabbiyn {shah-al-ab-been'}; plural from «07776»; fox-holes; Shaalbim or Shaalabbin, a place in Palestine:--Shaalabbin, Shaalbim.

H8170.def: patrial from «08169»; a Shaalbonite or inhabitant of Shaalbin:--Shaalbonite.

H8171.def: plural of «07776»; foxes; Shaalim, a place in Palestine:--Shalim.

H8172.def: a primitive root; to support one's self:--lean, lie, rely, rest (on, self), stay.

H8173.def: a primitive root; (in a good acceptation) to look upon (with complacency), i.e. fondle, please or amuse (self); (in a bad one) to look about (in dismay), i.e. stare:--cry (out) (by confusion with «07768»), dandle, delight (self), play, shut.

H8174.def: from «05586»; fluctuation; Shaaph, the name of two Israelites:--Shaaph.

H8175.def: a primitive root; to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear:--be (horribly) afraid, fear, hurl as a storm, be tempestuous, come like (take away as with) a whirlwind.

H8176.def: a primitive root; to split or open, i.e. (literally, but only as denominative from «08179») to act as gate-keeper (see «07778»): (figuratively) to estimate:--think.

H8178.def: from «08175»; a tempest; also a terror:--affrighted, × horribly, × sore, storm. See «08181».

H8179.def: from «08176» in its original sense; an opening, i.e. door or gate:--city, door, gate, port (X -er).

H8181.et: from (08175) in the sense of dishevelling
H8181.def: or sa.ar (Isaiah 7:20) {sah'-ar}; from «08175» in the sense of dishevelling; hair (as if tossed or bristling):--hair(-y), × rough.

H8182.def: from «08176»; harsh or horrid, i.e. offensive:--vile.

H8184.et: from (08175) in the sense of roughness
H8184.def: or snowrah {seh-o-raw'} (feminine meaning the plant); and (masculine meaning the grain); also s or {seh-ore'}; or s-owr {seh-ore'}; from «08175» in the sense of roughness; barley (as villose):--barley.

H8186.def: or shanariyriyah {shah-ar-ee-ree-yaw'}; or shaparurith {shah-ar-oo-reeth'}; feminine from «08176» in the sense of «08175»; something fearful:--horrible thing.

H8187.def: from «08176» and «03050»; Jah has stormed; Shearjah, an Israelite:--Sheariah.

H8188.def: masculine plural of «08184»; barley grains; Seorim, an Israelite:--Seorim.

H8189.def: dual of «08179»; double gates; Shaarajim, a place in Palestine:--Shaaraim.

H8190.def: of Persian derivation; Shaashgaz, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Shaashgaz.

H8192.def: a primitive root; to abrade, i.e. bare:--high, stick out.

H8193.et: probably from (05595) or (08192) through the idea of termination (compare (05490))
H8193.def: or (in dual and plural) sepheth {sef-eth'}; probably from «05595» or «08192» through the idea of termination (compare «05490»); the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.):--band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, ((sea-))shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.

H8194.et: from (08192) in the sense of clarifying
H8194.def: from «08192» in the sense of clarifying; a cheese (as strained from the whey):--cheese.

H8195.def: or Shphiy {shef-ee'}; from «08192»; baldness (compare «08205»); Shepho or Shephi, an Idumaean:--Shephi, Shepho.

H8196.def: or shphuwt {shef-oot'}; from «08199»; a judicial sentence, i.e. punishment:--judgment.

H8197.def: or Shphuwphan {shef-oo-fawn'}; from the same as «08207»; serpent-like; Shephupham or Shephuphan, an Israelite:-- Shephuphan, Shupham.

H8198.def: feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see «04940»); a female slave (as a member of the household):--(bond-, hand-)maid(-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

H8199.def: a primitive root; to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively):--+ avenge, × that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge(-ment), × needs, plead, reason, rule.
